name: Bodroghalom (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of white over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bodroghalom: a blue shield with a yellow fish and a plant, with a helm and white mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bodroghalom arms with helm and mantling
